description: Opinionated Fastify 5 + Effect backend framework: Effect Schema as type provider, controllers as Effect services, tagged errors mapped to HTTP, Pino↔Effect logging, SSE.
rules: Keel is glue only: it has no business logic and no application runtime. The app builds its own Effect ManagedRuntime and hands it to keel.
Validation uses Effect Schema as the Fastify type provider. Never reach for Zod or JSON Schema by hand in a keel app.
Controllers are built with controller() and return an Effect, never a raw Fastify reply. Response shape is expressed with the Http* result types (HttpCreated, HttpNoContent, ...).
Failures are tagged errors mapped to HTTP statuses, so fail the Effect instead of throwing.
effect, fastify, pino, pino-pretty and the @fastify/* plugins are peer dependencies and must stay that way: two instances of effect in one process break Context.Tag identity.
Import from the entry point that matches the surface being used: @kylobyte/keel (http + runtime), /http, /runtime, /sse, /sql, /openapi.
The /sql, /openapi and helmet peers are optional, and the /sql ones are pinned to exact versions because Drizzle's Effect driver is prerelease and moves with @effect/sql.
